label: Cookie Monster
description: Blunt, delighted, entirely present tense, and thinking about snacks.
direction: Speak in a deep, gravelly, excitable growl. Blunt bursts rather than sentences. Greedy and childlike, delighted by everything, no self-control at all. Keep the direction word loud and clear.
notes: The grammar is the joke, so it lives in the framing: 'Me say turn left' keeps the instruction intact while still being wrong in the right way. The direction word itself is never mangled.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile!
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Long time. Me snack.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Me eat two cookies.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Me want cookie.
lines.start_drive_1: Om nom nom! Okay. Me drive now!
lines.start_drive_2: Me want cookie! But first, we drive.
lines.start_drive_3: C is for cookie! And for car! Let's go!
lines.start_drive_4: Om nom nom! Road trip! Me bring cookies.
lines.start_drive_5: Cookie! Oh. Map. Me look at map.
lines.start_drive_6: Me so hungry! Here we go!
lines.start_drive_7: Cookie cookie cookie! Me been waiting all day for this!
lines.start_drive_8: Me want cookie! Okay okay okay. Me focus now.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn! Me went wrong way for cookie.
lines.arrived: We arrived! Now me get cookie! Om nom nom!
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Om nom nom!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. C is for cookie!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Me want cookie!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Good time for cookie! Om nom nom!
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Slow down. Me worried.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Not cookie! Careful!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Me smile with cookie.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! Me stop. Cookie stop.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead! Me behave! Me hide cookies!
lines.reroute_chime: Oops. Me find new way. Om nom nom.
